Financial Reporting Risk: Unauthorized users may gain access to financial reporting systems
Control Objective: Ensure financial system access is authorized
Control Description: New user access requires documented approval from the employee's manager and application owner before provisioning
Audit Procedure: Select new user accounts and verify approval preceded access provisioning
Evidence Required: Access requests; approval records; account creation logs

Financial Reporting Risk: Excessive privileges may permit unauthorized changes to financial records
Control Objective: Restrict privileged access to authorized personnel
Control Description: Privileged accounts are restricted to approved personnel and reviewed periodically
Audit Procedure: Inspect privileged account listings and verify documented reviews and exception resolution
Evidence Required: Privileged account listings; review sign-offs; remediation records

Financial Reporting Risk: Former employees may retain access to financial applications
Control Objective: Ensure timely removal of terminated employee access
Control Description: HR termination notifications trigger account disablement according to company policy
Audit Procedure: Compare sampled HR termination records with account disablement timestamps
Evidence Required: HR termination records; access logs; disablement tickets

Financial Reporting Risk: Inappropriate user permissions may remain undetected
Control Description: Application owners perform periodic reviews of user access and investigate inappropriate permissions
Audit Procedure: Inspect completed access reviews and verify identified exceptions were resolved
Evidence Required: User access listings; review sign-offs; remediation records

Financial Reporting Risk: Unauthorized production changes may affect financial calculations and reporting
Control Description: Production changes require documented approval before implementation
Audit Procedure: Select production changes and verify approval occurred before implementation
Evidence Required: Change tickets; approval records; deployment logs

Financial Reporting Risk: Untested changes may introduce errors into financial reporting applications
Control Objective: Ensure changes are adequately tested before release
Control Description: Changes undergo documented testing and review before production deployment
Audit Procedure: Inspect sampled changes for documented testing and approval of results
Evidence Required: Test plans; test results; change tickets

Financial Reporting Risk: Unauthorized personnel may deploy changes directly into production
Control Description: Production deployment permissions are restricted to authorized personnel and periodically reviewed
Audit Procedure: Inspect deployment permissions and verify periodic access review evidence
Evidence Required: Deployment access listings; permission configurations; review records

Financial Reporting Risk: Emergency changes may bypass normal authorization and testing procedures
Control Objective: Ensure emergency changes receive appropriate retrospective review
Control Description: Emergency changes are documented with justification and reviewed after implementation
Audit Procedure: Sample emergency changes and verify justification and retrospective review
Evidence Required: Emergency change tickets; approvals; post-implementation reviews

Financial Reporting Risk: Backup failures may result in loss of financial reporting data
Control Objective: Ensure financial system backups are monitored
Control Description: Backup jobs are monitored and failures are investigated and resolved
Audit Procedure: Inspect backup logs and verify failed jobs were investigated and resolved
Evidence Required: Backup logs; monitoring alerts; incident tickets

Financial Reporting Risk: Failed processing jobs may cause incomplete financial data
Control Objective: Ensure scheduled financial processing jobs complete successfully
Control Description: Critical financial processing jobs are monitored and failed executions are investigated
Audit Procedure: Inspect scheduled job logs and verify failed executions were investigated
Evidence Required: Job execution logs; exception records; incident tickets

Financial Reporting Risk: Unresolved IT incidents may disrupt financial reporting systems
Control Objective: Ensure incidents are appropriately tracked and resolved
Control Description: Incidents affecting financial systems are logged prioritized assigned and tracked through resolution
Audit Procedure: Sample incidents and inspect classification investigation and closure records
Evidence Required: Incident tickets; investigation notes; closure records

Financial Reporting Risk: Inadequate recovery arrangements may prevent restoration of financial systems
Control Objective: Ensure critical financial systems have tested recovery arrangements
Control Description: Recovery arrangements are documented and tested periodically
Audit Procedure: Inspect recovery test results and verify identified issues were tracked to resolution
Evidence Required: Recovery plans; test results; remediation records
